_doc: Tabbed panels (components/tabs.php). With JavaScript off every panel renders stacked with its own heading, so nothing is hidden behind a script. 'key' must be unique within the set. Copy this file and point another page at it with args.source.
title: Pick the way that suits you
sub: Same juice, three ways to get it.

tabs.label: At the counter
tabs.heading: Walk up and choose your stalk
text: No order needed and no waiting list. The board changes with what came in that morning, and the press runs all day.
points: Open seven days through the season
tabs.image_alt: The press running at the counter

tabs.label: Delivered
tabs.heading: Bottled and chilled to your door
text: Order before the afternoon cut-off and it is pressed the next morning and with you cold the same day.
Standing weekly orders can be paused any week without a phone call.
points: Reusable crates collected on the next run

tabs.label: At your event
tabs.heading: We bring the whole counter
text: A working press, the cane, the ice and two of our people, from eighty guests to four thousand.
We send your power and water requirements in writing as soon as a date is held.
points: Two hours to set up, one to clear
tabs.image_alt: The press set up at an event

tabs.label: Wholesale
tabs.heading: For cafes, shops and kitchens
text: Trade pricing by volume, a fixed delivery day each week, and the same pressing schedule as everything else we make.
points: Minimum order set per delivery area
Thirty-day terms after the first three months
tabs.image_alt: Crates ready for a wholesale run
